evaluation_framework: Enterprise AI Operating System (EAIOS) Quantitative & Qualitative Metrics

Task Decomposition Accuracy.description: Percentage of user prompts correctly mapped by Master Planner CoT reasoning into valid JSON task sequences.

Autonomous Self-Correction Rate.description: Percentage of SQL and analysis runtime errors caught and resolved independently via reflection loops.

BI Context Fallback Success Rate.description: Percentage of empty or errored data contexts successfully handled by automatic PostgreSQL fallback aggregation queries.

Pass@1 Execution Success Rate.description: Percentage of NL2SQL queries that execute on PostgreSQL on the first attempt without reflection.

Pass@3 Execution Success Rate.description: Percentage of NL2SQL queries that execute successfully after up to 3 reflection retries.

Forecasting MAPE.description: Mean Absolute Percentage Error of the statistical moving-average rolling velocity model against holdout sales data.

PDF Artifact Completeness.description: Completeness score for Autonomous_Executive_Report.pdf (structured metrics, summaries, charts, headers/footers).

End-to-End Latency.description: Total wall-clock latency from user intent input to final executive PDF compilation.

Component Execution Latency.description: Breakdown of execution latency per specialist agent node.

Peak Memory Usage.description: Maximum memory footprint measured during heavy 5,000-row DuckDB analytical query execution.

Baseline Memory Usage.description: System memory usage at idle baseline before workflow dispatch.

Memory Leakage / Stability.description: Memory footprint stability confirmed across repeated pipeline runs via gc.collect() inter-agent sweeps.
